item.title: Jack DeJohnette
item.description: by Rick Mattingly Jack DeJohnette died on October 26, at age 83. He was usually labeled as a “jazz drummer,” and gigs with Charles Lloyd, Miles Davis, Keith Jarrett, John Abercrombie, Ornette Coleman, Pat Metheny, and others put him at the top of the jazz elite.
